## Scope

Problem and resulting behavior; identify intentional non-goals.

## Contract impact

Authoritative files affected; PLAN/journal/recovery compatibility and authorization for any semantic change.

## Verification

Quick/Full results, runtime/platform actually executed, and checks not run with reasons.

## Runtime claims

Distinguish deterministic fixtures, synthetic/no-model controls and authorized live evidence. Preserve NOT PROVEN and known host limitations.

## Docs and migration

User-facing changes, CHANGELOG/compatibility impact, and migration only when needed.
